title: Brand Applications – Lukas Ude
description: The logo system applied to print and merchandise: business cards, embossing, cap and shirt.

thumbnail.alt: Black business cards with the Lukas Ude logo and wordmark on dark stone

body: A brand only becomes real when it leaves the screen. The applications test the logo where it has to work hardest: small, embossed, embroidered and on textured material.
The monochrome logo and generous clear space from the CI keep every application calm and recognisable.
